scope: Publication-package verification using the latest supplied manuscript and supplementary document, stored aggregate outputs, static code checks, privacy screening, and cleanup-preservation checks. No model fitting or new statistical resampling was performed for this release.

source_package_integrity.scope: Released-file integrity and syntax; no model fitting or historical analysis rerun

main_manuscript_and_figure_crosscheck.basis: Full-precision aggregate results compared with rounded document tables; exact figure inputs resolved.

latest_supplementary_crosscheck.scope: Latest attached supplementary Tables S28–S37 versus archived aggregate CSV outputs; no individual records, model fitting or new bootstrap

stored_representative_metrics.scope: Stored aggregate-output validation; refit validation is provided separately.
stored_representative_metrics.calibration_slope_for_document: Original stored calibration_slope preserved; strict MLE slope is a separate numerical check only.

cleanup_preservation.scope: README and table-reference documentation were updated. The verifier excludes the removed archive. Historical statistical code, aggregate estimates, frozen selections, and execution receipts are preserved.

python_syntax_and_comment_policy.scope: AST parsing, compilation, token inspection, and byte comparisons. CLI help strings and executable shebangs are preserved.

public_content_screening.scope: Content-level privacy and credential screening; not a licence/redistribution ruling.
public_content_screening.conclusion: No participant records, identifier arrays, individual predictions, participant fold assignments, resampling multiplicities, or API credentials were found. All CSV/JSON datasets are aggregate analytical outputs, configuration records, or questionnaire/provenance metadata.

interpretation_limits: This release verifies correspondence and preservation of existing results; it is not an independent replication from participant-level source data.
No full repeated nested cross-validation, full block-attribution analysis, alternative-outcome fitting, new bootstrap, or original representative-model refit was run during this publication cleanup.
Historical validation records describe their original execution dates and environments. Their recorded source hashes are not rewritten to match later formatting or packaging changes.
Only the listed manuscript tables and checks were audited here. The counts do not assert that every manuscript sentence, citation, or numerical statement was independently verified.
Privacy screening examines visible data structures and apparent credentials; it is not a licence or redistribution-rights ruling.

release_integrity.scope: The manifest is generated after this validation record and covers every public release file except the manifest itself. Historical manifests and removed archive contents are excluded.
